added_test_explanation: A filesystem symbolic link redirects a path to another file. This test creates a real link and checks that the exporter rejects it instead of treating it as an approved source file. The skip occurs during link creation, before that rejection assertion. It therefore records a coverage gap, not a failed exporter check or a passing security test. [E25]

A separate targeted recheck on 5 September 2026 attempted the same unchanged test: zero passed, one skipped and zero failed. An independent link-creation probe returned Windows error 1314, 'A required privilege is not held by the client.' No system settings or repository code were changed. This explains the current capability failure; the earlier log did not capture its error code. The retained 48-test result remains 47 passed and one skipped. The recheck is not a full-suite rerun or a release gate. [E25]
